DEVA Hub

A space that
holds the encounter

The DEVA Hub space is primarily intended for psychotherapy and counseling work, in a calm setting made for focused, undisturbed sessions.

The Spaces

A space that follows
your rhythm

Body-oriented practice

The rooms are adapted to different forms of therapeutic work, with a focus on body psychotherapy and somatic practice.

Equipped for the work

Therapists have access to appropriate props and equipment for body-oriented work, including a massage table.

Open to practitioners

DEVA Hub also welcomes other professionals who work in direct contact with clients and need a pleasant, comfortable and equipped space for individual sessions and work with smaller groups.
